localizations.en: Scouting complete. Land and air both covered.

999008199.text:
大きい建物が１つあっただけで、他は全部
こんな感じの景色だったわ

localizations.en: There was one big building, but everything else looked just like this.

999008199.text: 建物？　どんな感じのやつ？

……あんな構造物、今まで見たことがない。
どう言ったらいいか、難しい

localizations.en: ...I've never seen anything like it. It's hard to describe.

999008199.text:
そうね、あたしの世界でもちょっと見たことがないわ。
果ての大陸人のすみかなんじゃない？

localizations.en: Same here—nothing like it in my world, either. Could be where the people of World's End live?

999008199.text:
そんな人類がいる？　いや、待てよ……
もしかしてパルメ族？

localizations.en: People? Wait a minute... Could it be the Palme?

999008199.text: ちょっと……知ってたなら教えてよね

localizations.en: Hey—if you knew, you could've just said so!

999008199.text:
答えというのは自分で考えて、導き出すことに
意味があると思わないかい？

localizations.en: Where's the fun in that? There's value in working things out for yourself, don't you think?

999008199.text:
まあ、否定はしないけど……手間とか効率とか
重視したほうがいい場面もあるでしょ

localizations.en: I won't argue with that, but there's something to be said for saving time and effort, too.

999008199.text:
というか、ここがパルメ族のすみかなら
師匠やザスキアさんもいるんじゃないの？

localizations.en: Besides, if this is the Palme's home... does that mean August and Saskia are here too?

999008199.text:
またまた正解。
きっと今頃みんなの到着を待っているはず

localizations.en: Another good guess. I'd bet they're waiting for everyone right now.

999008199.text: あの二人の気配はなかったけど

localizations.en: I didn't sense either of them nearby, though.

999008199.text:
ベップちゃんが言うならそうなんでしょうね。
留守にしているのかしら

localizations.en: If Bepp says so, I believe it. Perhaps they've stepped out.

999008199.text: シトリン、まだ何か隠してるんじゃないでしょうね？

localizations.en: Citrine, you're not hiding something else, are you?

999008199.text:
いや、これは僕にも予想外。
……パルメ族にとっても想定外の何かが起こった？

localizations.en: No, this one's a surprise to me too. ...Could something have happened that even the Palme didn't anticipate?

999008199.text: まあ、なんにせよ今度は俺たちも探索に参加しよう

localizations.en: Well, either way—let's get in there and take a look ourselves.

999008199.text: うん。行ってみましょう！
